training.best_epoch_note: 1-based epoch as in results.csv. Ultralytics saves best.pt only on strict fitness improvement, so the first epoch reaching the top score is kept; epochs 43 and 50 tie but do not replace it. The stored checkpoint shows epoch -1 because it was stripped after training.

limitations: No 'not a bin' class: cannot reject photos that do not show a bin.
Trained only on simulated images; real-image accuracy is much lower than validation.
Half-full photos are often predicted as full with high confidence.
